config.scope: Recover native spectral processing provenance, quantify retained historical continuum-fit channels and execute a conditional continuum-subtraction covariance benchmark. No galaxy gravity or motion fit.
config.history_contract: Retain each complete UVLIN history group, IF/channel weights and polynomial order, the IMAGR channel range/averaging/increment, source identifiers, subsequent processing task names and exact source-card indexes. Bind the complete header and raw cube hashes.
config.direct_channel_mapping_contract: Map output channel j (zero-based stored FITS order) to BCHAN+j only if there is exactly one UVLIN group and one IMAGR group; UVLIN output name/class/sequence equals IMAGR input; NCHAV=CHINC=1; ECHAN-BCHAN+1=NAXIS3; a complete single-IF weight vector covers the output range; no post-UVLIN spectral-combination or regridding task is recorded. MOVE/RENAM/TVFLG/UVFLG/IMAGR/AIPS are allowed but flags remain a covariance limitation. Otherwise retain unresolved provenance without guessing a mapping.
config.continuum_operator: For explicitly mapped simple cases only, A=S-X_out (X_cal^T W X_cal)^-1 X_cal^T W P_cal. Compute A C A^T. This exact linear-algebra identity is only a conditional image-domain surrogate for visibility-domain subtraction, not a replay of per-visibility flagging, imaging weights or nonlinear CLEAN.
toy_input_channel_covariances: independent unit variance convolved spectrally with [0.25,0.5,0.25], normalized to unit variance away from boundaries

native_spatial_transfer_diagnostic.selection: Only the mapped historical continuum-fit channels, without choosing channels by the current image values. They are candidates defined by provenance, not certified line-free measurements.
native_spatial_transfer_diagnostic.center: Native spatial FITS reference pixel; this diagnostic needs no galaxy velocity or fitted geometry.
statistics: Per-channel median and Gaussian-scaled MAD in each region
Inner/outer robust scale ratios and signed tail asymmetry
Adjacent-channel residual products only within contiguous mapped intervals

nonclaims: Historical continuum channels are not independent observing epochs
A missing retained continuum channel does not establish that all output channels contain emission
AIPS metadata alone does not recover unrecorded online spectral response or per-visibility flags
A Gaussian restoring beam alone is not the interferometric noise covariance
No new mask, source mass, 3D depth or gravity residual is fitted

exposure: Native header histories were inspected to declare this contract. Existing galaxies are development-exposed. No new galaxy motion fit occurs.
